name: Kotonoha Honyaku
description: Kotonoha Honyaku — a translation studio theme read like an unrolled vertical scroll: under a formal top header the page runs top to bottom, the services hang from one long ruri thread as numbered rows, and in Chinese and Japanese every section head becomes a vertical title slip down the right edge (Latin text always stays horizontal). The header splits the menu around the centred studio name, with the Ask for a quote button at its end; phones and tablets get a full-screen ruri overlay. Ruri (#1E50A2), the deep lapis blue of traditional Japanese dyeing, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are ruri fields set in paper white, with pale shell-pink labels. The hero is a scene map: the title, lead and buttons beside a risograph map of the harbour town in a paper frame, with this week's three jobs pinned on it as numbered labels, and a cut-out fountain pen (transparent WebP) breaking over the frame and the hero bottom edge; a cut-out desk globe breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a two-colour risograph illustration in ruri and soft vermilion. BIZ UDPMincho for display, Bricolage Grotesque for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-12 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, scene-map hero, split nav, cutout-break-frame, risograph, ruri #1E50A2, BIZ UDPMincho + Bricolage Grotesque, business-services). A formal top header with the studio name centred between the menu and the Ask for a quote button. Vertical type only in Chinese and Japanese; Latin text stays horizontal. Break-frame: the cut-out fountain pen breaks over the map frame and the hero bottom edge, the cut-out desk globe over the story band and every page head.

summary.zh-TW: 琉璃藍的翻譯工作室：港町地圖主視覺標出本週案件、去背鋼筆破格而出、服務如直式卷軸展開、孔版印刷風插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A ruri blue translation studio: a harbour map hero with pinned jobs, a cut-out pen breaking out, services as a scroll, risograph art.
summary.ja: 瑠璃色の翻訳事務所。今週の仕事をピンで示す港町の地図、枠を越える万年筆、縦の巻物のような業務紹介、リソグラフの挿絵。
summary.fr: Un atelier de traduction bleu ruri : carte du port avec les travaux épinglés, stylo détouré qui déborde, services en rouleau, risographie.
summary.de: Ein Übersetzungsbüro in Ruri-Blau: Hafenkarte mit markierten Aufträgen, freigestellter Füller, Leistungen als Rolle, Risografie.
